subject: Freeway POC — rundown, milestones & owner rotations
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Freeway POC — initial plan & success criteria

Hi Daniel — great conversation earlier today. Appreciate the context on Aperture's search/triage workflow. Per our discovery, here's a compact POC approach so we can align internally and get you to a conclusive readout quickly.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood inference latency, cost, and extraction quality on Aperture sample queries and a ~200k notes dataset.

Proposed success criteria (measurable)
1) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end generation < 600ms for 512-token prompts under your expected QPS (baseline: 5qps)
2) Precision: Top-3 extraction match >= 88% against your labeled set (we'll provide an eval harness)
3) Cost: Token cost within 25% of our benchmark for equivalent model/config
4) Ops: KV / prefix cache reduces repeat token cost by >= 30% for conversational flows

Timeline (suggested)
- Kickoff: May 19 (suggested) — 60–90m technical + stakeholder alignment
- Trial window: 3 weeks (May 19 — June 9)
- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays, 10:00am PT (progress, blockers, metric readouts)
- Final readout: Jun 9 — 45m + results deck

Owners (Redwood)
- Jonas Weber — infra & onboarding (S3/ingest, tokens, runbook)
- Marissa Cole — evaluation & success metrics (eval harness, dashboards)
- Ben Carter — customer success / exec liaison (pricing & procurement coordination)

Data / security notes we need from Aperture\- Sample schema + 1k-row CSV (anonymized) or S3 path with read-only credentials\- Any PII constraints / allowed masking approach\- Preferred region (us-west/us-east/eu) for residency during the trial

Attachments: Freeway_POC_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (mutual action plan), Freeway_POC_SLA.pdf (template SLA) — both attached.

Next steps
- Please confirm kickoff date (May 19 works?)
- If yes, can you share a sample dataset and let us know who on your side will be the technical lead (cc'd Sarah if possible)?

Thanks — I'll prep a one-page pre-kickoff checklist once you confirm the date.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

Attachment: Freeway_POC_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: Freeway_POC_SLA.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Daniel Park <daniel@aperturehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah@aperturehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Freeway POC — initial plan & success criteria

Thanks Camila — this looks promising. Two quick items from our side:
1) Timeline: May 19 kickoff is OK but can we start the technical session at 10:00am PT instead of 11:00? That helps our EU team join at the tail end.
2) Data residency / PII: we'll need the trial to run in us-east and we require an HMAC-based masking step for direct PHI fields before ingestion — can you confirm Redwood supports that in a private trial?

Sarah (cc) will be our technical lead. I'll have procurement start an MSAL/PO request — they may ask for a SOC2 attestation and a copy of the SLA. I'm attaching our network diagram for the infra team to review.

If you can send a minimal schema (column names + types) for the 1k sample, we'll get that to Sarah by EOD Monday.

— Daniel

Attachment: aperture_network_diagram.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@aperturehealth.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Freeway POC — initial plan & success criteria

Daniel — great, 10:00am PT on May 19 is fine. Confirming the following updates and our internal commitments below.

Updated plan\- Kickoff: May 19, 10:00am PT (calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=freeway-kickoff-20270519)\- Trial window: May 19 — Jun 9\- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays 10:00am PT (May 25, Jun 1, Jun 8)\- Final readout: Jun 9 (45m)

Security / residency\- Redwood can run the trial in us-east. For PHI, we recommend an ingest-time HMAC + tokenization pipeline — Jonas will own the runbook and will coordinate with Sarah for the exact hashing salt/approach.

Action items (owners & timelines)\- Jonas Weber (Redwood) — set up ingest S3 path, ephemeral credentials, and pre-kickoff test pipeline (due: May 17)\- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — baseline eval harness + initial metric dashboard (due: May 24)\- Ben Carter (Redwood) — procurement touchpoint; will share MSAL template and liaise with procurement@aperturehealth.com (due: May 14)\- Sarah Kim (Aperture) — provide 1k anonymized sample + schema and confirm data residency details (due: May 16)

Pre-kickoff checklist (what we will send)
- Shared Drive with mutual action plan and runbook\- Short architecture diagram for trial (network/ports)\- Data schema + sample ingestion instructions\- Meeting agenda for kickoff

References
- Mutual action plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FreewayPOC
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-AP-2027-0317

Camila will pull together the pre-kickoff checklist and the SOC2/SLA artifacts for procurement. Jonas — can you confirm the ingest method (S3 vs direct upload) and whether you want the sample via a signed S3 URL?

Thanks all — excited to get started.

Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@aperturehealth.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Freeway POC — initial plan & success criteria

Camila / Daniel — confirmed. We'll use a signed S3 URL for the sample ingest (short-lived) and an ephemeral token for the trial pipeline. High-level checklist for our infra path:
- Create read-only ingest bucket + signed URL (Camila/Jonas) — note: advise 24h expiry, AES-256 server-side encryption\- Pre-kickoff smoke test with 10 sample rows to validate schema and masking\- Baseline model run to surface typical token count and expected 95th latency

I'll aim to have the ingest path and smoke test ready by May 17. Marissa / I will sync on the eval harness scope (Marissa: can you confirm which metrics you want surfaced at each weekly readout?).

Jonas

I'll share the 1k sample and schema with Sarah and we should have that over by May 16.

Thanks,
Daniel
